ios.desc:
Your personal finance AI Agent. Spend less, save more, and reach your dream goals — a home, a car, a vacation, or just peace of mind — with insights that actually understand your situation

FEATURES                                                                                                                            

• Unlimited AI Tracking — Track your spend automatically on every Apple Pay tap or Bank SMS
• Voice AI Agent — Plan your trips, discuss budget, set saving goals, analyze spending patterns. Powered with your data
• Savings Goals — Add your savings goals and track your progress in real time
• Scheduled Reports — Receive recap of your spend - daily, weekly, monthly, annually at your preferred time
• Manual Entry — Add your salary, transfers, bills, purchases manually anytime
• Expenses Limit — Set your daily, weekly, monthly budget and stay on track with Push Notifications 
• Live Activity — Forget about impulsive purchases and track your budget on Lock Screen with Live Updates


- Terms & Conditions: https://dibba.ai/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://dibba.ai/privacy
- Contact Support: support@dibba.ai
